Hello,

I opened RMA *Shop····* for my KBox (serial *····*) on *7
October*. Since then I have not received the return label or any written
confirmation by email.

In the chat on *15 October*, your team confirmed in writing that:

   - “You bought from us, the warranty is ours”;
   - I would receive a *prepaid label, with no customs or extra cost* to me;
   - the return route and a *replacement KBox from your EU warehouse* would
   be confirmed by email.

None of this has arrived yet. Please send me the prepaid return label and
the written confirmation of the EU replacement *by Friday 23 October*.

I have attached screenshots of the chat for reference.

Hi Patrick,

Thank you for the screenshots, and I'm sorry you've had to chase this since 7 October. That wait is on us.

What you were told stands, and I've put it in writing here too: you bought the KBox from us, so the warranty is ours. The return will be prepaid, with no customs charges and no cost to you, and the replacement KBox comes from our EU side. Sorting out GekkoScience is our side of it, not yours.

Where it stands right now: your KBox shipped to you direct from GekkoScience rather than out of our own warehouse, so the return label for that route has to be bought by a colleague rather than generated here. I've put the whole case in front of the team with your serial ····, the (address hidden) address unchanged, the complete unit coming back with the integrated power supply, and your Friday 23 October deadline. They are offline for the evening and pick it up tomorrow morning, and the label plus the written confirmation of the EU replacement come to you by email at this address.

When the label arrives, please write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box. You don't need to send anything to us again, everything is on the ticket.

Sorry again for the back and forth on this one.

Kind regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hi Mike, hi Mierra,

I’m writing to you directly and would appreciate a *personal reply from a
member of staff*, not from the automated assistant.

The timeline of my RMA *Shop····* (KBox *····*):

   - *7 October*: RMA opened.
   - *19 October*: you confirmed in writing that the warranty is yours,
   that the return is prepaid with no customs or costs for me, and that the
   replacement comes from your EU stock. A colleague was to send the label the
   next morning.
   - *21 October*: I sent a reminder.
   - *23 October*: you promised me an update “well before Tuesday”.

Today is Tuesday 27 October, three weeks after I opened the RMA, and I
still have no label and no explanation.

Honestly, this doesn’t feel right. When I had questions about prices or
delivery, you answered within a day or two. Your socials always show a very
positive picture, but now that I need after-sales service, I’m left waiting
for weeks for something as simple as a return label. Warranty support is
part of what I paid for, and it’s what you have already confirmed in
writing.

Please send the prepaid return label, or a clear explanation of what is
holding it up, *by Friday 30 October*. I’d rather solve this directly with
you than share my experience publicly.

Kind regards,
Patrick B.
